# Lead Engine

> Lead Engine builds inquiry pipelines for B2B manufacturers, industrial suppliers, brand owners and distributors selling across borders. Two lines feed one pipeline: an outbound line (researched, one-to-one email to decision-makers) and a GEO line (Generative Engine Optimization, so ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and other AI assistants name the client when buyers ask who to source from). The output is A/B/C-graded qualified inquiries.

## Key facts
- Name: Lead Engine
- Who it serves: export-oriented manufacturers, brand owners, traders and distributors, and niche specialists in any industry
- Industries: all industries; work to date covers chemicals and advanced materials, machinery and precision parts, electronic components, feed additives and bio-based products, consumer goods and home, textiles. Strongest with spec-heavy technical products
- Target markets: North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East and South America
- Model: two lines, one pipeline. Outbound line (ACTIVE, "we go to the buyer") and GEO line (PASSIVE, "AI brings the buyer to you"), on top of a network of scenario sites
- GEO core capabilities: (1) semantic restructuring and Schema markup, (2) authoritative content seeding with external cross-verification, (3) competitor-model mapping for "alternative to [brand model]" queries
- Outbound core: 100+ paid global data sources in six categories, 8-dimension account research, one-to-one emails (30,720 structure combinations, no subject/opener repeat on the same domain within 60 days), five-touch follow-up
- Measured value (ranges from past client work, not a guarantee): AI mention rate up 30%–70%; inquiry intent about 2.8× higher; blended acquisition cost down about 55%
- Self-run test on our own chemical export business: 2,500+ personalized emails, 30+ inquiries (about 1.2% inquiry rate), including 6 sample requests
- Founder: Jackson Jiang, from fine chemicals and industrial export sales
- Free entry point: AI Visibility Audit Report, delivered in 3 business days

## Plans
All plans are custom-quoted (pricing on request) by markets, languages and volume.
- Outbound line (billed monthly, plus a one-time setup fee):
  - Starter: 1 scenario site, 5,000 sends/month
  - Standard: 3 scenario sites, 20,000 sends/month
  - Flagship: 7-site network, 50,000 sends/month
  - 15% off when outbound is paid annually
- GEO line (billed annually):
  - Foundation: website Schema markup overhaul, AI-readable content seeding for the top 3 products, AI crawler access and llms.txt
  - Growth (most popular): full product-line semantic modeling, competitor-model mapping, application-scenario content, high-authority external source content, monthly mention-rate report
  - Leader: multilingual content seeding across markets, technical white papers, academic and trade media endorsement, algorithmic defense build-out
- Two-line bundle (outbound line plus a GEO plan): 30% off the GEO plan
